founder.heading: Know the Founder
founder.intro: SRI is a founder-led organisation guided by the philosophy of Sustainable Rural Innovations.

founderDraft: A veterinary professional and rural enterprise development specialist with experience spanning livestock-based businesses, agribusiness development, farmer producer institutions, business strategy and organisational management. His professional interests include building sustainable rural enterprises, strengthening farmer-owned institutions and promoting entrepreneurship through innovation and professional management.
